Class ColumnTypeRegistry

Namespace
ParquetNeo.ColumnTypes
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

Finds the ColumnType<TValue> that reads and writes values of a .NET type: the built-in ones, any enum (as the name of its value), and the ones added with Register<TValue>(ColumnType<TValue>). The serializer uses it to decide how a property is stored, so registering a column type teaches it a new type for its properties.

RegisterEnum<TEnum>()

Registers the column type of an enum (its values stored as their names). Enums are found without this when the program can make generic types at run time; with Native AOT it makes the enum known to the compiler, so call it once for each enum that the serializer reads or writes (the generated mapping of a type does it for the enums of the type).

public static void RegisterEnum<TEnum>() where TEnum : struct, Enum
